name: audience-discounts
title: Audience discounts
description: Startups, students and nonprofits: a card per group with who qualifies, how much off as the biggest figure and how to apply, so nobody has to ask.
docs: Pass a title, two to four programs, an optional description and a note about how you check. A program is an id, the audience, the discount, an optional duration, the eligibility as a list of lines, an action and an optional icon. The discount is real text set as the biggest thing on the card, with the duration under it; eligibility is a list so it can be scanned; the action is an object with a label that names the group, such as Apply for the student discount, and either an href or an onClick, and it renders as a link or a button accordingly. Cards are articles in a list, and the columns follow the count so no card is left alone in a row: two groups stay a pair, three go from one column to three, four from two to four, and a single one stays a card. The cards share their rows through a subgrid, so the figures, the dividers, the lists and the buttons line up from one card to the next, and the buttons fill the row so they are equally tall. The note sits beneath with a shield icon. labels translates the small line above each list of conditions.
